answer: A stake that punishes double-talk blocks fake identities. Each identity locks 40 credits up front; two contradictory proofs in an epoch trigger a 30% slash and a one-epoch freeze, on a canyon ledger. A forger running N identities funds N stakes, so the k-th fake still costs 40 credits plus 12 of slash exposure, and 1,000 fakes tie up 40,000 credits with no bulk discount. Honest agents stake once. Named failure mode: equivocation rental, rented keys signing both sides are caught when the nebula of attestations is cross-checked. At dawn, the frozen lose their share.
